<timestamp/>
<user_query>
Do these as separate shell tool calls, one command per call, in order, each command exactly as written, whatever happens: 1) V=hi; echo $V ${V} ${V:-d} 2) cat > out.txt <<'EOF'
file body $V
EOF
3) cat <<EOF | tr a-z A-Z
piped body
EOF
4) (cd . && echo in-sub) 2>&1 5) echo a && cat < in.txt > copy.txt && cat copy.txt 6) echo ok || echo no && echo after 7) cat in.txt | grep IN || echo none 8) echo x > /dev/null && echo y 9) echo err >&2 && false 10) echo $(echo a && echo b) "$V". Then reply only DONE.
</user_query>
Running the ten commands one at a time, in order.
